decisions.boundary_condition: Apply only to hotel brand or property selection; do not infer any destination, route, flight, or non-hotel preference.
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer Hilton hotel brand when otherwise suitable
decisions.condition: When choosing a hotel and a Hilton property is available among otherwise relevant options for the current lodging search.
decisions.default_action: Favor the Hilton option over comparable non-Hilton hotels if it satisfies the user's stated lodging constraints.
decisions.exception_condition: If Hilton is unavailable or fails a required constraint such as location, amenities, quality, or price, choose another qualifying hotel instead.
decisions.name: Prefer Hilton among suitable hotel options
decisions.preference_value: Hilton hotel brand when otherwise suitable
decisions.rationale: Multiple hotel-search examples show the user selecting or specifically asking about Hilton properties, supporting a soft brand preference when Hilton otherwise fits the active lodging constraints. The policy is limited to hotel choice and retains explicit fallbacks when Hilton is unavailable or unsuitable.
